name: TPWF Shorebird Habitat Management and Restoration Fund
summary: Grants to restore and enhance shorebird habitat on Texas public lands, funded by the Knobloch Family Foundation. NGOs and government-sponsored partners working with public land managers can apply.
reporting: Final report within 30 days of project completion

eligibility.rule: Project benefits resident and/or migratory shorebirds in Texas
Project occurs on public land owned by a city, county, state, or federal entity
Works alongside a city, county, state, or federal land manager
Project duration is at most six months
At least one other contributor supports at least 25% of the total project cost

documents: Statement of collaboration from the partnering public land entity

status.quote: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis. Grants will be available until funds are expended.

applicant_types.quote: eligible applicants include non-governmental organizations or government-sponsored partners working alongside city, county, state, or federal land managers

geography.quote: This initiative aims to restore and enhance shorebird habitat on Texas' public lands

access.quote: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis.

amount.quote: The fund offers targeted grants ranging from $5,000 to $30,000 per project

window.quote: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis. Grants will be available until funds are expended.

co_finance_required.quote: Project must include at least one other contributor supporting at least 25% of the total cost.

reporting.quote: If awarded, grantees will be required to submit a final report within 30 days of project completion.
